lines: Hollins played 67% of snaps over his last 3 games and saw 5.3 targets per game, which is the same target pace as his season.
Over those 3 games he averaged 10.2 PPR points, 3.7 catches and 45.7 receiving yards per game.
Week 12 is at LAC, which allows the 7th-most PPR points per game to WRs, though NE's implied team total is only 17.0 points.
